I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

The source is that channel itself, which Tobias is a member of. On 2025-09-03, Priyanka reported that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. At 18:43 that day she said labels were printing again and Southgate had cleared the backlog.

I couldn't find an address for Southgate. There are no Tansley account files in the share, so I suggested he ask Priyanka if he needs one. I didn't use message search, since its results include conversations Tobias can't see.
